text: 1、市场早间低开震荡，三大指数集体调整。短剧、影视股逆势大涨，上海电影、中广天泽、博纳影业、欢瑞世纪等多股涨停。液冷概念股持续活跃，金富科技、金帝股份、新朋股份、康盛股份等涨停。房地产板块高开回落，我爱我家、深物业A、天保基建、广宇集团等涨停。下跌方面，贵金属板块下挫，莱绅通灵、湖南白银跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市超3000股飘绿，上午半天成交1.32万亿。午间收盘沪指跌0.2%，深成指跌1%，创业板跌1.29%。 2、板块概念方面，影视短剧、液冷服务器、煤炭、消费电子等板块领涨；贵金属、医药医疗、光伏设备、汽车整车等板块领跌； 3、两市共2221只个
text_en: 1. Markets opened lower and fluctuated in the morning, with all three major indices adjusting collectively. Short-drama and film/TV stocks bucked the trend with sharp gains, as Shanghai Film, Zhongguang Tianze, Bona Film and Huanrui Century hit limit-up. Liquid cooling concept stocks remained active, with Jinfu Technology, Jindi Shares, Xinpeng Group and Kangsheng Shares hitting limit-up. The real estate sector opened higher but pulled back, with 5i5j, Shenzhen Properties A, Tianbao Infrastructure and Guangyu Group hitting limit-up. On the downside, the precious metals sector fell, with Laishen Tongling and Hunan Silver hitting limit-down. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with over 3,000 stocks in Shanghai-Shenzhen-Beijing markets turning red. Morning turnover was 1.32 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.2%, the Shenzhen Component fell 1%, and the ChiNext fell 1.29%. 2. By sector, film/TV short drama, liquid-cooled servers, coal and consumer electronics led gains; precious metals, pharma/medical, PV equipment and auto assembly led losses. 3.
